many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# vertical-flip about object bottom edge variant (never tried): out = obj + obj[:-1][::-1]
for p in [1,2]:
    a=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; b=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    S=min(i for i,r in enumerate(a) if any(x==6 for x in r))
    cand=a[:S]+a[S-1::-1][:H-S-1]  # object + flipped copy filling to bottom
    print(p,'cand == out:', cand==b)
ti=G['Test input']
S=max(i for i,r in enumerate(ti) if any(x==4 for x in r))+1
out=ti[:S]+ti[S-1::-1][:11-S]
print(json.dumps(out))

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    S=max(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x==6 for x in r))
    obj=g[:S]                 # rows strictly above last 6-row; check height
    cand=obj[::-1]
    out=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        out.append(row[:])
    # clear marker
    for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(S+1) for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x==6]:
        out[r][c]=0
    # paste flipped copy immediately below the object (starting at S - len(obj))
    start=S-len(obj)
    for i,row in enumerate(cand):
        out[start+i][0:W]=row[:]
    return out
for p in [1,2,3]:
    r=f(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,'match:',r==e)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    i=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    Fs=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c,x in enumerate(i[r]) if x==4]
    Ms=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c,x in enumerate(i[r]) if x==6]
    As=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c,x in enumerate(o[r]) if x==4 and (r,c) not in set(Fs)]
    Os=set(Fs)
    # find translation best fitting As
    best=None
    for dr in range(-H,H):
        for dc in range(-W,W):
            ok=sum(1 for (r,c) in As if (r-dr,c-dc) in set(Fs))
            if best is None or ok>best[0]: best=(ok,dr,dc,len(As))
    print('pair',p,'best fit:',best)
    print('  marker bbox rows',min(r for r,_ in Ms),max(r for r,_ in Ms),'cols',min(c for _,c in Ms),max(c for _,c in Ms))
    print('  obj bbox rows',min(r for r,_ in Fs),max(r for r,_ in Fs),'cols',min(c for _,c in Fs),max(c for _,c in Fs))
    # also check whether copy equals full object translated, and any missing cells
    (ok,dr,dc,n)=best
    pred={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in Fs}
    print('  pred==added?',pred<=set(As),'missing',sorted(pred-set(As)))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# f: find object (non-zero non-marker color), reverse vertically, place directly below object, erase marker
def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    obj=[k for k,v in c.items() if k!=6][0]
    # bounding box of object
    rs=[r for r in range(len(g)) for cc,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x==obj]
    rc=[cc for r in rs for cc,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x==obj]
    minr,maxr=min(rs),max(rs); minc,maxc=min(rc),max(rc)
    h=maxr-minr+1
    rev=[g[maxr-i][minc:maxc+1] for i in range(h)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,rowrev in enumerate(rev):
        rr=minr+h-1+i  # directly below: starts at maxr+1
        for j,v in enumerate(rowrev):
            out[rr][minc+j]=v
        # remove marker cells that overlap or lie within copy area? marker sits at bottom anyway here
    return out
for p in [1,2]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    r=f(gi)
    print(p, r==go)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def analyze(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    O=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(gi) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==4]
    Mk=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(gi) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==6]
    A=set((r,c) for r,c in zip(*np.where(np.array(go)==4)))
    res=[]
    def transforms(o):
        yield 'id',o
        yield 'h',[ (r,-c) for r,c in o]
        yield 'v',[ (-r,c) for r,c in o]
        yield 'p',[ (-r,-c) for r,c in o]
    for name,th in transforms(O):
        for dr in range(-H,H+1):
            for dc in range(-W,W+1):
                S={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in th}
                if S!=A or S&set(Mk): continue
                res.append((name,dr,dc))
    return n,res,Mk,O,A

for n in range(1,6):
    n_,rs,Mk,O,A=analyze(n)
    print('=== demo',n_)
    for nm,dr,dc in rs:
        print('   ',nm,'shift',(dr,dc))
    mrs=sorted({r for r,c in Mk}); mcs=sorted({c for r,c in Mk})
    orows=sorted({r for r,c in O}); ocols=sorted({c for r,c in O})
    print('   marker bbox rows',mrs[0],mrs[-1],'cols',mcs[0],mcs[-1])
    print('   obj bbox rows',orows[0],orows[-1],'cols',ocols[0],ocols[-1])
